h:
我尝试使用工作流程来测试 loras。我自己不是技术人员，但我想制作一个适合我的产品，每次我尝试新下载的工作流程时，它就像是人间地狱，摆弄着像不成熟的成年人一样的节点。工作流程中包含说明。

用途：测试 Loras 的不同场景。角色（姿势、动作、与其他洛拉结合……）、风格、概念……

此工作流程主要适用于 SDXL 模型。 （小马、显赫、卑鄙……）

o.en:
My attempt at a workflow to test out loras. Not a techie myself but I want to make one that works for me, every time I try out new downloaded workflows it's hell on earth, fiddling around with nodes that acts like immature adults. Instruction included in the workflow.

Usage: To test different scenarios of your Loras. Characters (poses, actions, combining with other loras,...), style, concept,...

This workflow is mostly for SDXL models. (pony, illustrious, base,...)
